title: Sample Toy
tagline: A fixture that stands in for a well-behaved daily build.
description: A tiny cellular automaton with a palette picker. It exists only to prove the validator accepts honest work.
intro: A toy that draws an elementary cellular automaton: a row of cells where each new row follows from the one above by a fixed rule. It is for anyone curious how simple rules make complex patterns. Press Step to grow one row, or Play to watch it run; change the rule number to see another pattern.
credits: Built by the Sonnet Every Day team
